import gzip,hashlib,json,os,stat
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("/home/qian-qi/heptabao-bao-acceptance-unified-61ff-20261104-r1/normal-workspace")
expected={"workspace.stdout":"5ef24325975a5a429f7a32a580e00978cb5a7446620675d5f191f105f6d738e6","workspace.stderr":"60296106862fcad2b1c498790bd03eb3c88fbb83a57476c5c5763e4ff2719be5"}
def identity(s): return (s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_mode,s.st_uid,s.st_nlink,s.st_size,s.st_mtime_ns,s.st_ctime_ns)
files={}
for name,pin in expected.items():
 path=root/name
 fd=os.open(path,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW)
 try:
  before=os.fstat(fd)
  assert stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_uid==1000 and before.st_nlink==1 and before.st_size<=2*1024*1024
  chunks=[]
  while True:
   part=os.read(fd,65536)
   if not part: break
   chunks.append(part)
  raw=b"".join(chunks)
  assert identity(before)==identity(os.fstat(fd))==identity(path.lstat())
  assert len(raw)==before.st_size and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==pin
  files[name]={"bytes":len(raw),"sha256":pin,"text":raw.decode("utf-8")}
 finally:
  os.close(fd)
raw=(json.dumps({"schema":"heptabao.normal-workspace-original-logs.v1","files":files},sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(",",":"))+"\n").encode()
packed=gzip.compress(raw,compresslevel=6,mtime=0)
path=root/"full-logs-r1.json.gz"
fd=os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
with os.fdopen(fd,"wb") as stream:
 stream.write(packed);stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
dfd=os.open(root,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY)
try: os.fsync(dfd)
finally: os.close(dfd)
assert path.read_bytes()==packed
print(json.dumps({"status":"verified_original_public_logs_packed","path":str(path),"gzip_bytes":len(packed),"gzip_sha256":hashlib.sha256(packed).hexdigest(),"raw_bytes":len(raw),"raw_sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"files":{k:{a:b for a,b in v.items() if a!="text"} for k,v in files.items()}},sort_keys=True))
